name: Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript
description: Frontend governance for Next.js App Router, React Server Components, TypeScript strictness, accessibility, and Core Web Vitals.

evaluators.name: Next.js App Router, RSC Boundaries & TypeScript Evaluator
evaluators.scope: Server vs Client Component ('use client') boundaries, Server Actions auth/validation, streaming/Suspense caching semantics, zero secret leaks to client bundles, and strict TypeScript contracts.

evaluators.name: UI, Accessibility & Core Web Vitals Evaluator
evaluators.scope: WCAG/ARIA semantics, :focus-visible, mobile 320px-375px layout stability, next/image and next/font usage, and LCP/INP/CLS Core Web Vitals budgets.

pr_checklist: Server/Client Component boundaries preserve `'use client'` at leaves with zero server secrets or non-`NEXT_PUBLIC_*` env vars leaked to client bundles
Audited accessibility (ARIA semantics, `:focus-visible`, `type="button"`), mobile layout, and Core Web Vitals (`next/image`, `next/font`, LCP/INP/CLS)
Type check (`npx tsc --noEmit`), lint (`npm run lint`), tests (`npm test`), and production build (`npm run build`) pass
agents_md_rules: **Frontend (Next.js App Router & TypeScript):** Whenever modifying `app/`, UI components, Server Actions, or client hooks, follow [`.agents/skills/frontend-nextjs-ts/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/frontend-nextjs-ts/SKILL.md).

steps.name: Install dependencies
steps.run: if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; else npm install; fi

steps.name: Type check
steps.run: if [ -f tsconfig.json ] && [ -x node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then npx --no-install tsc --noEmit; else echo 'No tsconfig.json or local tsc found; skipping type check'; fi
